ledger: Skateboarder | riding forward | lands trick | moves through skatepark
Skatepark concrete | flat and curved ramps | similar features | geometry shifts slightly during camera moves
Background trees | line of trees | line of trees | shapes and positions warp and morph during camera pans
Light poles | tall poles with lights | tall poles | disappear, reappear, and shift relative to trees

findings.description: As the camera tilts up during the first trick, the background trees morph in shape and the light poles on the right disappear, completely altering the established scene layout.
During the second trick, the pair of light poles visible on the left earlier disappears, and the tree line warps, changing the relative positions of the background elements again.
